name: agent-hub
description: Multi-agent workflow for Claude Code: the main thread routes each request by a lane table to brainstorm, scout, designer, implement, reviewer, test and devops agents, with OpenSpec plan, spec and review gates.

reply_language.title: Reply language
reply_language.description: Language code (ISO 639-1, for example en, vi, ja) for replies, questions to you and the plan summary file. Files the agents read stay in English.

research_cache_dir.title: Research cache folder
research_cache_dir.description: Folder where the agents keep what outside sources (docs, papers, vendor pages) were found to say, so the same research is not repeated. Empty means research-cache inside your Claude config folder.

moment_hooks.title: Moment hooks
moment_hooks.description: on or off. When on, the plugin hands an agent a rule at the moment it applies (the research cache index before a web search, for example). off turns every such hook off.

hook_blocks.title: Blocking checks
hook_blocks.description: on or off. When on, three checks may refuse a step of an agent, each at most twice per agent run: the implement agent editing code before a test run or committing with no Refs: line, and any agent's final report in the wrong shape. off turns each into a reminder.

read_guard.title: Read guard
read_guard.description: on or off. When on, reading a whole file longer than read_guard_lines lines or larger than read_guard_bytes bytes, with the Read tool or a plain cat, is refused and the agent is told to read it in parts.

read_guard_lines.title: Read guard line limit
read_guard_lines.description: Largest number of lines a whole-file read may return. Default 200.

read_guard_bytes.title: Read guard size limit
read_guard_bytes.description: Largest size in bytes a whole-file read may return. Default 16384 (16 KiB).
